recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a vertical column of large, stenciled sans-serif letters formed from dense, shimmering gold particles against a solid black void. A delicate, white calligraphic script is layered horizontally across the center, creating a textural and formal contrast between the heavy, granular verticality and the light, fluid horizontality.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stenciled mass versus horizontal fluid script
Granular gold texture versus solid black negative space
Large-scale block lettering versus small-scale intricate calligraphy
coreInvariants: Gold glitter/dust texture for primary text
Vertical orientation of the primary word
Central horizontal overlay of secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary text is centered vertically, spanning nearly the full height of the frame. Secondary text is centered horizontally and vertically, acting as a focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection of the white script and the gold particle column.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical column from top to bottom, then rests on the central white script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive black space on the left and right sides emphasizes the central vertical column.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright gold/white and the zero-value black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif for vertical; Spencerian script for horizontal
letterConstructionRules: Vertical letters are formed by a dense spray of gold particles, creating soft, blurred edges.
Horizontal script features extreme thick-to-thin transitions and elongated flourishes.
The vertical text is rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the vertical column lack hard outlines, defined only by the density of gold dust.

composition.overlap: placed on top of gold text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast: massive, textured, vertical sans-serif paired with delicate, smooth, horizontal script.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the large word
avoid: Hard outlines on the gold text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, flourished calligraphic style of the overlay.
Provides the geometric skeleton for the vertical particle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black canvas with a central vertical column of shimmering gold dust particles forming large, blurry-edged geometric uppercase letters rotated 90 degrees.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a delicate, white, high-contrast calligraphic script horizontally across the center of the gold column.

verificationChecks: Is the gold text vertical and rotated?
Is the texture granular like sand or glitter?
Is the white script centered and legible?

adjustableVariables: Gold hue (rose gold vs yellow gold)
mustRedesign: Specific brand names or artist signatures
Exact letter spacing of the original script

mustAchieve: Clear distinction between the two text layers
avoid: Flat yellow color instead of gold texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for particle diffusion at the edges of the gold letters.
Ensure the white script is not lost against the gold background.
Verify the vertical alignment is perfectly centered.
Confirm the black background is free of noise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical [Texture] [Font Style] + Horizontal [Color] [Script Style] on [Solid Color] background.
